sv.title: Man i 25-årsåldern skärskadad i Osby – en gripen
sv.summary: Under natten till onsdag fick polisen larm om en man med stick- eller skärskador i Osby. En man har gripits, misstänkt för grov misshandel.

en.title: Man in his mid-20s with cutting injuries in Osby – one arrested
en.summary: During the night to Wednesday, police received an alarm about a man with stab or cutting injuries in Osby. One man has been arrested on suspicion of aggravated assault.
